name: Second MTP Synovitis / Predislocation Syndrome
definition: Painful inflammation and instability of a lesser metatarsophalangeal joint, commonly the second, often preceding plantar-plate failure and crossover-toe deformity.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs assess alignment; ultrasound/MRI is used when plantar-plate pathology is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Progressive instability may require surgical correction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-anguli Sandhi phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful inflammation and instability of a lesser metatarsophalangeal joint, commonly the second, often preceding plantar-plate failure and crossover-toe deformity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
